services.name: Yoga
services.desc: Our two yoga spaces offer the perfect balance of energy and relaxation-like Yin and Yang, sun and moon, light and dark. The Rev Room is our heated space, designed to invigorate both body and spirit. Whether you're flowing through Power Yoga or pushing through Hot Pilates, every class here will elevate your heart rate, challenge your strength, and leave you feeling sweaty and accomplished. On the other hand, the Restore Room is where you go to slow down and recharge. This non-heated space offers calming classes like Yin, Restorative, Mindful Flow, and Vinyasa, perfect for those days when your body and mind need a softer touch.
